events.text: Editing-in-loader-pane handed off (this session is enormous; editing must be host-side, NOT React Scene3D). Brief: /tmp/handoff-20260624-152649-loader-iso-pane-native-editing-picking-placement-ghost.md

resolution: Restored native map editing in the loader-rendered iso build pane WITHOUT reintroducing the React Scene3D world render (the measured ~683MB/boot path the loader pane was built to kill). LoaderIsoView is now a second thin consumer of the SAME renderer-agnostic primitives IsoAuthor uses: GAME_BUILD.placed raycast/placementFor/validatePlacement/connected/bounds + IsoStage pieceRay/groundPoint + resolveSnapTarget, committing the SAME piecePlaced/buildingMoved/pieceRemoved/buildingRemoved events on the SAME world stream. Functional: arm a catalog piece via the SAME CatalogRail (exported from IsoAuthor), click ground to place (piece/prefab/water), click to select (shift = whole building), drag to move (cell-snapped, building-aware), Del delete, R rotate ghost, Esc disarm. Visual feedback is a 2D projected HUD (ghost box + selection outlines via Graph.Polyline in an identity view, pointerEvents off) projected with a new IsoStage.project() wrapping GAME_CAMERA.worldToScreen — the proven meshSelect.tsx overlay, not a second React 3D surface. Verified: bundle resolves+parses clean, hooks unconditional. Live interaction (place/select/move/ghost) needs user test via hot-reload — headless shot can't drive a mouse and uses the stale embedded bundle.
